messages.author: 77657e4bc4b5e029
messages.subject: R function "sapply" issue
parts:
Hi fellow,

I am puzzled by this issue.  I have one line of code:

sapply(kvars,function(vv) sapply(peps$peptide,kidera,factor=vv))


"peps$peptide" is a list.  The above line works as intended when I have more than one peptide sequences in "peps$peptide".  But it behaves strangely when I only have one peptide sequence in "peps$peptide".  The following is from R console:
 
     1.  three sequences:

 

> peps$peptide

[1] "AEPHFFDRSYDKGLAWYRS"   "AEPHFFDRSYDKGLAWYRST"  "AEPHFFDRSYDKGLAWYRSTW"

 

> kvars

       side.chain.size   occurrence.alpha.reg        helix.bend.pref

     "side.chain.size" "occurrence.alpha.reg"      "helix.bend.pref"

 

> sapply(kvars,function(vv) sapply(peps$peptide,kidera,factor=vv))


                      side.chain.size occurrence.alpha.reg helix.bend.pref

AEPHFFDRSYDKGLAWYRS         0.1505263          0.085789474       0.1589474

AEPHFFDRSYDKGLAWYRST        0.1080000          0.024000000       0.1640000

AEPHFFDRSYDKGLAWYRSTW       0.2028571          0.003809524       0.1704762

 

  1. one sequence:

 > peps$peptide

[1] "AEPHFFDRSYDKGLAWYRS"

 

> kvars

       side.chain.size   occurrence.alpha.reg        helix.bend.pref

     "side.chain.size" "occurrence.alpha.reg"      "helix.bend.pref"

 

> sapply(kvars,function(vv) sapply(peps$peptide,kidera,factor=vv))

 

    side.chain.size.AEPHFFDRSYDKGLAWYRS

                              0.15052632

occurrence.alpha.reg.AEPHFFDRSYDKGLAWYRS

                              0.08578947

     helix.bend.pref.AEPHFFDRSYDKGLAWYRS

                              0.15894737

 

"kvars" is a list (vector).  You can see when the user pastes only one peptide sequence, the line of code did not generate a data structure that is intended (a matrix with peptide sequences as row title).  Instead, it appended sequence (AEPHFFDRSYDKGLAWYRS) to the column title.  This is not a problem when the input is more than 1 sequence (2, 3, …, 10, …).

 

How should I modify the R syntax so that it will work when there is only one peptide sequence in "peps$peptide"?

 

Many thanks!


Zhengping

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: R function "sapply" issue
parts: This is not really a Shiny question, you might have more luck posting a general R question on stackoverflow. That said, my one suggestion would be to pass simplify=FALSE to both the inner and outer sapply and see if that gives you more consistent behavior.
